name: FormField
description: Fieldset/legend wrapper for a group of controls (radio sets, checkbox clusters, composite fields), with a group description and a group-level error. Individual controls own their own label, error, and helper text.

keyboard: Tab — moves focus to the wrapped control.
ariaRequirements: Generates a stable id and wires `htmlFor` on the label and `aria-describedby` on the control to the helper-text element.
When `error` is set, the helper text renders inside `role='alert'` so the error announces on submit.
When `required`, the asterisk is decorative; the control owns `aria-required`.
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-05-28 — Bucket-1 beta port: keyboard/ARIA contract reviewed, ForcedColors story added, Storybook axe gate (parameters.a11y.test: error). 2026-07-07 — beta→stable: 4-mode AT (base/light/dark/forced-colors) verified on a non-6010 Storybook; accessibility tree and real-browser forced-colors confirmed.

forbiddenUse: Render a bare `<label>` + `<input>` next to a `FormField` in the same form; the visual rhythm desyncs.
Put two controls inside one `FormField` in single-control mode; wrap each in its own, or switch to group mode.
Provide both `label` and `legend`; pick one mode.
dense: fieldset/legend wrapper for a GROUP of controls with groupDescription + group-level error; single controls own their own label/error/helperText chrome

usage.description: FormField names a group of controls with a fieldset legend: radio sets, checkbox clusters, composite fields like a date range. Individual controls own their own label, error, and helperText (the field-wrapper convention), so FormField exists only for the group case, adding a legend, an optional description, and a group-level error.

bestPractices.description: Use it whenever two or more controls answer one question (Notification channels, Opening hours).
Write the legend as the question or category; each control's own label then reads as an answer.
Use groupDescription for guidance that applies to the whole set, like Pick at least one.
Put cross-control validation in the group error prop; per-control failures belong on the control's own error.
Do not wrap a single labeled control; TextInput, Select, Checkbox, and friends carry their own label, error, and helper text.
Do not use it as a layout box; it renders a real fieldset and its legend is announced on every control inside.

anatomy.name: Legend
anatomy.description: The group's accessible name; announced by assistive tech on every control inside the fieldset.

anatomy.name: Group description
anatomy.description: Guidance for the whole set, rendered under the legend.

anatomy.name: Controls
anatomy.description: The child controls; each keeps its own label and per-control error.

anatomy.name: Group error
anatomy.description: Cross-control validation message rendered after the controls with role=alert.
